component.name: HomeScene

Label.text: Tune in to the best content 24/7
↑ Categories · ↓ Channels · OK: Watch Now · ★ TV Guide · Back: Exit

component.script:
sub init() m.heroPoster = m.top.findNode("heroPoster") m.heroTitle = m.top.findNode("heroTitle") m.heroDesc = m.top.findNode("heroDesc") m.heroCategory = m.top.findNode("heroCategory") m.watchNowBg = m.top.findNode("watchNowBg") m.watchNowLbl = m.top.findNode("watchNowLbl") m.liveTvBg = m.top.findNode("liveTvBg") m.liveTvLbl = m.top.findNode("liveTvLbl")
m.categoryGrid = m.top.findNode("categoryGrid") m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") m.status = m.top.findNode("status")
m.selectedCategory = "All" m.focusZone = "grid" ' "hero" | "cats" | "grid" m.heroBtnIndex = 0 ' 0 = Watch Now, 1 = Live TV
m.categoryGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onCategorySelected") m.categoryGrid.observeField("itemFocused", "onCategoryFocused") m.grid.observeField("itemSelected", "onChannelSelected") m.grid.observeField("itemFocused", "onChannelFocused")
m.grid.setFocus(true) renderHeroButtons() fetchChannels() end sub
sub fetchChannels() m.status.text = "Loading channels…" m.fetcher = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ChannelsFetcher") m.fetcher.apiBase = m.top.apiBase m.fetcher.observeField("channels", "onChannelsLoaded") m.fetcher.observeField("error", "onChannelsError") m.fetcher.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onChannelsLoaded() payload = m.fetcher.channels if payload = invalid or payload.list = invalid m.status.text = "No channels returned" return end if m.channels = payload.list m.categories = buildCategoryList(m.channels) renderCategories() m.selectedCategory = "All" renderChannels() if m.channels.Count() > 0 setHeroChannel(m.channels[0]) end if m.status.text = m.channels.Count().ToStr() + " channels · Category: " + m.selectedCategory end sub
sub onChannelsError() m.status.text = "Network error: " + m.fetcher.error end sub
' -------- Category logic -------- function buildCategoryList(channels) as object counts = {} order = ["All"] counts["All"] = channels.Count() for each ch in channels cname = ch.category if cname = invalid or cname = "" then cname = "Other" if counts[cname] = invalid counts[cname] = 0 order.Push(cname) end if counts[cname] = counts[cname] + 1 end for list = [] for each name in order list.Push({ name: name, count: counts[name] }) end for return list end function
sub renderCategories() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each c in m.categories it = content.createChild("ContentNode") it.title = c.name it.description = "(" + c.count.ToStr() + ")" if c.name = m.selectedCategory it.shortDescriptionLine1 = "1" else it.shortDescriptionLine1 = "0" end if end for m.categoryGrid.content = content end sub
sub onCategoryFocused() idx = m.categoryGrid.itemFocused if idx < 0 or idx >= m.categories.Count() then return m.status.text = "Category: " + m.categories[idx].name end sub
sub onCategorySelected() idx = m.categoryGrid.itemSelected if idx < 0 or idx >= m.categories.Count() then return m.selectedCategory = m.categories[idx].name renderCategories() renderChannels() m.grid.setFocus(true) m.focusZone = "grid" end sub
' -------- Channel grid -------- sub renderChannels() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.visibleChannels = [] for each ch in m.channels cname = ch.category if cname = invalid or cname = "" then cname = "Other" if m.selectedCategory = "All" or m.selectedCategory = cname it = content.createChild("ContentNode") it.title = ch.name vcount = 0 if ch.videos <> invalid then vcount = ch.videos.Count() it.description = vcount.ToStr() + " videos" it.shortDescriptionLine1 = cname it.HDGRIDPOSTERURL = firstNonEmpty(ch.thumbnail, "pkg:/images/icon_side_hd.png") it.id = ch.id m.visibleChannels.Push(ch) end if end for m.grid.content = content end sub
sub onChannelFocused() idx = m.grid.itemFocused if m.visibleChannels = invalid or idx < 0 or idx >= m.visibleChannels.Count() then return setHeroChannel(m.visibleChannels[idx]) end sub
sub setHeroChannel(ch as object) m.heroChannel = ch m.heroTitle.text = UCase(ch.name) if ch.description <> invalid and ch.description <> "" m.heroDesc.text = ch.description else m.heroDesc.text = "Tune in to the best content 24/7" end if cat = ch.category if cat = invalid or cat = "" then cat = "TV" m.heroCategory.text = UCase(cat) m.heroPoster.uri = firstNonEmpty(ch.thumbnail, "pkg:/images/splash_fhd.png") end sub
sub onChannelSelected() idx = m.grid.itemSelected if m.visibleChannels = invalid or idx < 0 or idx >= m.visibleChannels.Count() then return openPlayer(m.visibleChannels[idx]) end sub
' -------- Hero button focus visuals -------- sub renderHeroButtons() if m.focusZone = "hero" and m.heroBtnIndex = 0 m.watchNowBg.color = "0xA855F7FF" m.watchNowLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.watchNowBg.color = "0x7C3AEDFF" m.watchNowLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" end if if m.focusZone = "hero" and m.heroBtnIndex = 1 m.liveTvBg.color = "0xEF4444FF" else m.liveTvBg.color = "0x00000000" end if end sub
' -------- Player + Guide -------- sub openPlayer(ch as object) m.status.text = "Tuning in to " + ch.name + "…" player = m.top.findNode("player") if player = invalid player = m.top.createChild("LivePlayer") player.id = "player" player.apiBase = m.top.apiBase player.observeField("closed", "onPlayerClosed") end if ' Pass the full visible channel list so the drawer / channel-up-down work. player.setField("channelList", m.visibleChannels) for i = 0 to m.visibleChannels.Count() - 1 if m.visibleChannels[i].id = ch.id then player.currentIndex = i end for player.channel = { id: ch.id, name: ch.name, thumbnail: ch.thumbnail } player.visible = true player.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onPlayerClosed() player = m.top.findNode("player") if player <> invalid then player.visible = false m.grid.setFocus(true) m.focusZone = "grid" end sub
sub openGuide() guide = m.top.findNode("guide") if guide = invalid guide = m.top.createChild("TVGuideScene") guide.id = "guide" guide.apiBase = m.top.apiBase guide.observeField("closed", "onGuideClosed") guide.observeField("selectedChannelId", "onGuideChannelSelected") end if guide.visible = true guide.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onGuideClosed() g = m.top.findNode("guide") if g <> invalid then g.visible = false m.grid.setFocus(true) m.focusZone = "grid" end sub
sub onGuideChannelSelected() g = m.top.findNode("guide") if g = invalid then return chId = g.selectedChannelId if chId = invalid or chId = "" then return for each ch in m.channels if ch.id = chId onGuideClosed() openPlayer(ch) exit for end if end for end sub
function firstNonEmpty(a as dynamic, b as string) as string if a <> invalid and type(a) = "String" and a <> "" then return a return b end function
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "options" or key = "info" openGuide() return true end if
if key = "back" player = m.top.findNode("player") if player <> invalid and player.visible player.visible = false m.grid.setFocus(true) m.focusZone = "grid" return true end if g = m.top.findNode("guide") if g <> invalid and g.visible onGuideClosed() return true end if return false end if
' Hero-zone key handling (buttons) if m.focusZone = "hero" if key = "up" ' Stay on hero; do nothing (already top) return true end if if key = "down" m.focusZone = "cats" m.categoryGrid.setFocus(true) renderHeroButtons() return true end if if key = "left" if m.heroBtnIndex > 0 then m.heroBtnIndex = 0 renderHeroButtons() return true end if if key = "right" if m.heroBtnIndex < 1 then m.heroBtnIndex = 1 renderHeroButtons() return true end if if key = "OK" if m.heroChannel <> invalid openPlayer(m.heroChannel) end if return true end if end if
' Categories/Grid zone: up navigates to hero buttons. if key = "up" if m.focusZone = "grid" m.focusZone = "cats" m.categoryGrid.setFocus(true) return true end if if m.focusZone = "cats" m.focusZone = "hero" m.heroBtnIndex = 0 renderHeroButtons() return true end if end if
if key = "down" if m.focusZone = "cats" m.focusZone = "grid" m.grid.setFocus(true) return true end if end if
return false end function
